title: SessLint Seal Ledger Entry v1
description: One line of a tamper-evident hash-chain ledger recording a SessLint check/verify/repair outcome. entry_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field; prev_sha256 binds each line to the previous line's entry_sha256 (GENESIS on the first). Content-free: hashes, verdict, code counts, optional minimized path, self-reported sealed_at only.

path.description: Minimized path of the subject artifact; omitted by --seal-no-path or non-file subjects (stdin).

verdict.description: Closed-vocabulary outcome of the sealed invocation (e.g. healthy/invalid/unsupported for check, ok/failed for verify, repaired for repair).

sealed_at.description: Self-reported UTC wall-clock time inside the hashed line; no trust anchor.

genesis_of.description: Optional: prior ledger's last entry hash, binding a rotated ledger's first line to its predecessor.
